shots.name: kaleidoscope-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Kaleidoscope card: the Preset menu showing Crystal, Segments 3, Rotation 0°, Source Angle 60°, Zoom 1.50, Center X and Center Y 0.50, Shape Circle and Frame Edges Mirror, beside a strip of the preview with the dancer's dress and legs folded into large mirrored facets
shots.caption: Kaleidoscope with the Crystal preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Segments: how many mirrored pairs. 3 — Rotation: spins the pattern. 4 — Source Angle: which slice the mirrors show. 5 — Zoom: how close the slice is.

shots.name: blockify-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Blockify card: Preset menu showing Arcade, then Block Size 20 px, Levels 4, Dither 0.75 and Amount 1, beside a strip of the preview with the dancer in chunky blocks
shots.caption: Blockify with the Arcade preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Block Size. 3 — Levels: shades per colour. 4 — Dither. 5 — Amount.

shots.name: quadtree-zoom-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Quadtree Zoom card: Preset menu showing Big Tiles, then Minimum Cell 16 px, Detail Threshold 0.015, Amount 1 and Speed 0, beside a strip of the preview with the harbour rebuilt from chunky tiles, large over the sky and smaller over the houses
shots.caption: Quadtree Zoom with the Big Tiles preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Minimum Cell. 3 — Detail Threshold. 4 — Amount. 5 — Speed.

shots.name: voronoi-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Voronoi card: Preset menu showing Stained Glass, then Cell Size 40 px, Amount 1 and Speed 0, beside a strip of the preview with the harbour broken into irregular cells of flat colour
shots.caption: Voronoi with the Stained Glass preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Cell Size. 3 — Amount. 4 — Speed.

shots.name: mirror-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Mirror card: the Preset menu showing Still Lake, Left / Right off, Top / Bottom on, Keep Left / Top, Center X and Center Y 0.50, Angle 0° and Frame Edges Mirror, beside a strip of the preview where the harbour town is reflected upside down below the middle of the picture
shots.caption: Mirror with the Still Lake preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Left / Right: mirror across the upright line. 3 — Top / Bottom: mirror across the level line. 4 — Keep: which side is copied. 5 — Angle: turns the lines.

shots.name: rgb-split-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with an RGB Split card: the Preset menu showing Glitch, Amount 0.020, Angle 0°, Mode Offset and Frame Edges Mirror, beside a strip of the preview where the dancer's arm and dress repeat in red, green and blue copies side by side
shots.caption: RGB Split with the Glitch preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Amount: how far the colours move. 3 — Angle: which way. 4 — Mode: a straight shift or a lens. 5 — Frame Edges: what fills in at the edge.
